posts.title: 20-Minute Upper Body Dumbbell Workout
posts.caption:
Upper body. 20 minutes. Living room.

Push-up, bent-over row, seated press, hammer curl, floor skull crusher. 3 sets each, 60 seconds rest. Two dumbbells and a couch.

Save this for tonight. Which move is hardest for you?

#fitdad #dumbbellworkout #upperbodyworkout #homeworkout #dumbbelldadsclub
posts.song_suggestion: Back in Black by AC/DC (dad classic). Start at the opening riff.

posts.title: Monday Night Football Commercial Break Workout
posts.caption:
Game on? Lift every commercial.

Pregame warm-up, one round every commercial break, push-ups when your team scores, plank finisher at halftime. Two dumbbells, couch in reach.

Bills or Vikings tonight?

#mondaynightfootball #fitdad #dadlife #homeworkout #dumbbelldadsclub
posts.song_suggestion: Seven Nation Army by The White Stripes (stadium classic). Start at the riff.

posts.title: Stop Eating Dinner Over the Sink
posts.caption:
Stop eating dinner over the sink.

Plate yours first. Protein first. Leftovers get a lid. Sit down to eat. Same food, better habits.

Be honest: how many chicken nuggets did you eat off their plates this week?

posts.title: You Don't Need to Lift Every Day
posts.caption:
You don't need to lift every day.

The CDC guideline for adults is muscle-strengthening activity on at least 2 days a week, working all major muscle groups. Two or three full-body nights is plenty. Walk on the off nights.

How many nights a week can you actually train?

posts.title: The One-Episode Dumbbell Workout
posts.caption:
One kids' episode. One workout.

Theme song warm-up. Then 10 squats, 10 rows each side, 10 push-ups and a 20 second plank. Repeat until the credits roll.

What show are your kids on repeat right now?

posts.title: 10-Minute Mobility for Desk Dads
posts.caption:
Desk all day? 10 minutes. Move better.

Cat-cow, world's greatest stretch, goblet squat hold, open book, half-kneeling hip stretch. One dumbbell, no mat required.

Save it as your warm-up. Where do you feel the desk the most?

posts.title: The Protein Window Myth
posts.caption:
Your protein shake can wait.

A meta-analysis on protein timing found total daily protein intake was the strongest predictor of muscle growth (Schoenfeld, Aragon and Krieger, JISSN, 2013). Get protein at every meal and stop panic chugging.

What's your go-to easy protein?
